Claude checks a video you analysed: it looks at every effect and names it - and learns from your verdicts when you send it your review.
Claude checks, improves or writes prompts: briefs, AI video and image prompts, hooks and scripts.

Claude makes a video from zero: a motion-graphics video written as HTML and rendered to your song, or the plan of a video for AI video tools with every prompt.

Claude prepares what you say on camera: it checks a script you have against what makes talking videos hold attention (hook, structure, re-hooks, call to action) and rewrites it in your voice - or writes one from zero from your answers to a few questions.

Claude writes what makes people click - and what the video then keeps: about ten titles, two or three thumbnail ideas with the words on them and the shot to film, the hook that keeps the promise.
